content.text:
Any Growth engineer can sign off on it. As of 2026-09-01 the notifier belongs to the Growth team, and template and copy changes are approved in #growth-eng. This comes from the project's memory store. The repo has no CODEOWNERS file or other written approval rule to check it against.

An older memory said Dana Okafor had to approve these changes before merge. Dana has since moved to Platform, so that memory is out of date. I marked it as challenged and superseded by the newer ownership memory.

Receipt email changes also have to follow the template convention. The templates live in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. Each one needs a plain-text twin, `<event>.txt`, with the same variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML. If you edit the wording in the `.mjml` file, make the same edit in the `.txt` file.
